query:
SELECT (occurred_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::date AS "day!",
                   count(*)::bigint AS "n!"
            FROM activity_events
            WHERE subject_id = $2
              AND occurred_at >= ($3::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE $1)
              AND occurred_at <  ($4::date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE $1)
            GROUP BY 1
            ORDER BY 1
